items.title: Dynamic context loading: NPC-like interaction layer instead of full-context prompts
items.body: Instead of sending the LLM all possible context, give it an interaction layer: scripts/commands that perform lookups from world state, provided to the decision and mutation DMAs.

items.title: Populate more location edges in seeds
items.body: World content: more location edges in the seed data.

items.title: Improve daily work options
items.body: Broaden / improve the daily work option set.

items.title: 0 stamina blocks more actions; 0 HP triggers a death save
items.body: Hitting 0 stamina should block more actions that day. 0 HP should do this but also roll the dice - a death save. Note: death track is deferred from POC by design ([[the-poc]], [[mvp-progression]]).

items.title: Last stand buttons/captions: emojis + combat scene frame
items.body: Last stand buttons and captions need to look cooler: emojis or a combat scene frame.

items.title: Short rest granted after clearing hostiles as last action of the day
items.body:
Clearing bad people in an unsafe space should grant a short rest if it is your last action of the day (helps reach the Oak at night; slightly risky).

Also: add a short-rest variant usable once per day before or between actions. Drop blocker.

items.title: Evolving art block across consecutive decision screens
items.body: On consecutive action decision screens the art block should evolve/update (zoom or change the scene). The inline art block no longer has to display HP if the main frame does.

items.title: Opening frame on auto-resolved actions (travel/rest)
items.body: ANSI-F review gap. Travel/rest often resolve at start with no decision beat, so they show no opening frame today (3 auto-finish call sites + the public-broadcast embed question). Extend the frame to the outcome path.

items.title: Combat opening frame renders 'Unknown foe' pre-first-step
items.body: `PipelineDecideResult.combatEnemy` exists but is not exposed publicly. Enrich when worth it.

items.title: Cartographer enrichment: bounded retry sweep for failed enrich()
items.body:
N2 residual. Mint-to-fire wiring is fixed (`mintedSince` diff fires the async cartographer for freshly-crossed frontiers), but an `enrich()` that throws is only `console.warn`-logged and leaves the row `enrichment_pending = 1` forever - nothing re-attempts it.

Add a bounded retry/reconciler (sweep pending rows on tick, capped by a retry counter) so a transient LLM failure self-heals.

items.title: Fragment catalogue: enemy sprites, NPC busts, campfire, PC poses
items.body: Gates real art in opening/combat frames; until it lands, sprite/scene slots render as deliberate placeholder scenes. See [[ansi-art-classification-framework]] sec.9, [[mvp+ansi-art]]. The single next bottleneck for POC+ art coverage.

items.title: Migrate ascii to ansi in semantics, source files, and references
items.body: The 23 `assets/scenes/*.ascii` still coexist with the new `src/render/` ANSI system.

items.title: Render ANSI as images for mobile
items.body: Colour degrades to monochrome on mobile today. Longer-term, MVP+ wants the ANSI engine rewritten into compiled pixel-art images.

items.title: Stage-2 BROADCAST_CARD frame
items.body: Reuses the renderer; built when stage 2 (nat 1/20 broadcast) lands.

items.title: Richer /hi opening prose scaled by time since last interaction
items.body: Player request F#2 (2026-07-08, BendiusOver). Pressing Hi should generate a prose opener that scales with time since last interaction (referencing days or a few actions) and reminds the player of their work, quests, loose ends. Extends the morning/evening custom prose and add-/hi-to-new-hero items.
